column1: # Rationale sentence templates per verb (docs/plan/04). Slots: {material} {form} {attr} {use}.
# zh/en apply to matrix recipes (with a form); zh_nf/en_nf are the no-form variants used by
# chem/component recipes ({material} then holds the product name).

column2: {material}经破碎机粉碎分选,得到便于后续处理的碎料。{attr},{use}。
column3: {material} is crushed and sorted into workable feedstock. {attr}, {use}.

column2: {material}入炉熔炼提纯,铸成标准锭料。{attr},{use}。
column3: {material} is smelted and cast into standard ingots. {attr}, {use}.

column2: 按配比合炼成{material},冶金性能优于单一金属。{attr},{use}。
column3: Alloyed to spec into {material}; better metallurgy than any single metal. {attr}, {use}.
{material} ingots are cast and rolled into {form}. {attr}, {use}.
{material} stock is machined into {form} to tolerance. {attr}, {use}.

column4: 压制成型得到{material},结构致密。{attr},{use}。

column2: 蒸馏提纯{material},馏分各归其用。{attr},{use}。
column3: Distillation refines {material}; each fraction has its use. {attr}, {use}.

column2: 化工釜内受控反应制得{material},产物配比稳定。{attr},{use}。
column3: A controlled reaction yields {material} at stable ratios. {attr}, {use}.
column4: 化工釜内受控反应制得{material}。{attr},{use}。

column2: 深冷压缩液化制得{material},便于储运与加注。{attr},{use}。
column3: Cryogenic liquefaction yields {material} for storage and fueling. {attr}, {use}.

column2: 培养槽内受控增殖,产出{material}。{attr},{use}。
column4: 培养槽内受控增殖产出{material}。{attr},{use}。
